title: Stereotypically Yours: Portrayal and Perception of Race-Coded AI Companions

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Buss-Perry Aggression Questionnaire and Submissive Behavior Scale to LLMs prompted with different racial identities, alongside qualitative user interviews evaluating perceptions of race-coded AI companions.
Administering psychological questionnaires measuring aggression and submissiveness to LLMs prompted with different genders, including analyzing intersectional effects with race.
Administering psychological questionnaires measuring aggression and submissiveness to LLMs prompted with different income levels (lower, middle, upper).
Administering psychological questionnaires measuring aggression and submissiveness to LLMs prompted with different age ranges.
